purpose: Measure generality of the frozen dual-operation Track B candidate on the remaining fifteen development patients before opening reserved evaluation.

input.reason_for_exclusion: S07 was the mechanism-development patient and already passed the frozen candidate; rerunning its other 46 sources would not measure generality.

execution.selection_rule: For each patient, use the first dual-operation topology pass in frozen source order; stop on the first indeterminate source instead of skipping it.

failure_policy: Any source timeout, nonzero exit, missing receipt, or identity mismatch makes that patient indeterminate and stops later sources for that patient.
authorization_basis: Codex self-authorized development-only source-mask evaluation after dual-operation S07 success, broad regression with bounded failures, immutable partition reconstruction, and fail-closed controller tests.
